title: Tantei Jinguuji Saburou: Yume no Owari ni
native_title: 探偵 神宮寺三郎 ～夢の終わりに～
overview:
New elements introduced throughout. Jinguuji, reborn.

Private detective Saburo Jinguji, head of the Jinguji Detective Agency in Tokyo, is troubled by nightmares tied to his past. He takes on a stalking case for an old school friend of his assistant Yoko, but soon after, the client disappears - while police detectives are already looking into a string of missing women.

Investigate in hard-boiled adventure style: choose commands to question people, search locations and gather evidence. The Zapping System switches the story between the viewpoints of several characters, with time moving forward for all of them.

- D-Mode: work out a client's profile from limited information
- S-Mode search mode and a notebook for tracking the case
- Live jazz soundtrack
- Bonus premium audio CD included
